items.title: Polymarket Halted International Trading After Hackers Drained Accounts
items.content_html:
The company says an unnamed third-party provider was compromised. Trading has resumed, and Polymarket says affected traders will be made whole.

Source: WIRED · 2026-10-29

Tags: #Business #Hack Attack #科技 #社会
